channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new AI, Tech & Research grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • India Foundation for the Arts: Arts Research Programme (May 2026 Request for Proposals)
    https://indiaifa.org/whats-new/ar-rfp-may2026.html
    India Foundation for the Arts (IFA) · deadline Closed 10 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 500,000 (around USD 5,700 / EUR 4,900) per project. Honorarium is capped at 35 percent of the budget. Institutional overhead, building costs, infrastructure and equipment purchases are excluded. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
